name: perpetua
description: Liquid veBTC with a MUSD coupon, on Mezo

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix contracts install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.build: npm --prefix contracts run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:fork
scripts.test:unit: npm --prefix contracts exec -- hardhat test test/streamer.ts --network local
scripts.test:fork: npm --prefix contracts exec -- hardhat test test/locker.ts test/mezo-integration.ts --network mezoFork
scripts.deploy:testnet: npm --prefix contracts exec -- hardhat run scripts/deploy.ts --network mezoTestnet
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix contracts run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.seed:testnet: npm --prefix contracts exec -- hardhat run scripts/seed.ts --network mezoTestnet
